name: Tatternack Steelforge
summary: On the Barrens frontier, Tatternack Steelforge offers work to travelers who can handle raw metal and dangerous wildlife. The orc smith studies local ores and seeks to arm Horde forces against threats across the plains.

sections.title: An Orc at the Forge
sections.body: Across the Barrens, Horde outposts need weapons to face wild beasts, centaur raiders, and hostile quilboar. Tatternack Steelforge brings his people's metalworking knowledge to the frontier. He seeks practical weapons and unusual geological specimens to strengthen the Horde's foothold against those threats.

faq.answer: Tatternack Steelforge is an orc weaponsmith stationed in the Barrens. He helps supply Horde defenders by inspecting minerals, studying local ores, and putting reliable weapons into nearby warriors' hands.

faq.q: Where can Tatternack Steelforge be found?
faq.answer: Tatternack operates in the Barrens, residing among Horde camps along the central savanna trails.

faq.q: What kind of tasks does Tatternack offer?
faq.answer: Tatternack asks travelers to recover weapons and bring him fresh ore samples from around the Barrens for his forging work.

angles.text: For smiths traveling through the Barrens, Tatternack understands the need for good ore and quality steel in a lawless borderland.
Tatternack helps keep Horde forces armed and supplied against threats such as quilboar and centaur.
